query: Arm Neoverse data center infrastructure royalty growth
normalized: arm center data growth infrastructure neoverse royalty

output.content:
Arm’s Neoverse-led data-center royalty business is growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year rate**: data-center royalties **more than doubled** in Q1 fiscal 2027, continuing the same “more than doubled” performance reported in the preceding period. [[1]] 

The company does not disclose the absolute dollar amount of data-center royalties, so an exact segment revenue growth rate cannot be calculated; “more than doubled” implies growth of **over 100% year over year**. [[1]] 

The broader royalty base grew **22% year over year to $715 million** in Q1 FY2027, supported by higher royalty rates from Armv9 and Arm Compute Subsystems (CSS), plus greater deployment of Arm-based chips in data centers. [[1]] 

Neoverse adoption is the central driver: cumulative Neoverse shipments exceeded **1.5 billion cores**, while the latest 500 million cores shipped in only **nine months**, versus six years for the initial one billion. [[1]] 

For context, in Q3 FY2026 Arm’s total royalty revenue grew **27% to $737 million**, and management attributed growth partly to AI and general-purpose data-center demand; it characterized data-center royalty growth as triple digit. [[2]]
